name: Papra
author: Alwin Antreich
description: Save attachments to Papra and attach documents from Papra to new mail. Each user connects their own Papra API key to the server the admin sets.

serverUrl.label: Papra server URL
serverUrl.description: For example https://papra.example.com. Users connect their API key to this server only; the plugin does nothing until it is set.

defaultTags.label: Default tags
defaultTags.description: Comma-separated tag names added to every document saved from Bulwark, for example Bulwark. Create them in each Papra organisation: the plugin creates no tags and skips one the organisation doesn't have. Users need an API key with tags:read and documents:update for tagging.

en.dialog.title: Save to Papra
en.save.missing_defaults: Not added, {organization} has no such tag: {tags}
en.save.cannot_tag: Your API key can't add tags, so the document is saved without tags. A key with tags:read and documents:update can.
en.save.no_organizations: Your API key sees no organisation in Papra.

en.connect.needed: Connect your Papra API key to use Papra on {host}.

en.error.not_configured: Papra isn't set up yet. Ask your administrator to set the Papra server URL.
en.error.not_connected: Connect your Papra API key first.
en.error.key: Papra refused the API key, or the key lacks a permission for this.
en.error.key_permissions: The API key lacks these permissions: {missing}. Create a key with them in Papra.
en.error.wrong_server: This key belongs to another server. Connect it again.
en.error.wrong_server_connect: Connect the key to {server}. Other servers can't be used.
en.error.too_large: The file is too large for Papra.
